name: fonts_latin
_comment: Accented glyph fonts without a model: Latin-1 Supplement + Latin Extended-A for French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Czech, Hungarian and Turkish (dialogue, and a brass title in capitals), with the coverage check against strings_latin.csv (a Godot translation CSV): the pack fails, naming language and string id, if a string uses a character the font lacks. Authored: written with Claude (Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).
